description: This file defines data structures, enums, and class interfaces related to Type1/Type2 font encoding and font face representations within the FreeType project. It includes definitions for font encoding, font data, and face classes used in font rendering.

classes.name: T1_FaceRec_
classes.description: Represents a Type1 font face with font info, encoding, and auxiliary data.

classes.name: CID_FaceRec_
classes.description: Represents a CID font face with CID-specific data and subroutines.
